prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with neck and back strain after a parking lot collision. The patient had 25 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1168; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Some exam findings support the injury; other tests are normal.
- Years ago the patient had a small strain in the same area that healed fully.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a low-speed collision in a parking lot with complaints of neck and back strain. The mechanism of injury is consistent with the reported impact, and the symptoms described fit that force well. Over the course of 25 visits, care proceeded along a typical trajectory of manual therapy, targeted exercise, and home stretching, with visit frequency tapering as pain and mobility improved. Physical examination revealed some objective findings, including reduced cervical range of motion and paraspinal muscle tenderness, while other provocative tests and neurological screening were within normal limits. The patient reports a remote history of a minor strain in the same region that resolved completely without lasting limitation, and this was considered in the assessment. Billing records reflect single entries for each service without duplicated charges. At discharge, the patient was improving and was advised to continue an independent home exercise program.
